situations.title: First Step
body: The villa gates swing open. Inside: music, ring lights, and a pool throwing off gold. Two weeks ago, one of your reels blew up overnight — and now you're here.
Four creators are already inside. Ria's on the sofa, sunglasses on. Zoya's got her smile preloaded. {crush} and {ally} were saying something — now they're both quiet.
Every eye lands on you at once. You only get one first impression.

react.text: Oh damn, the viral one is here 😭 now let’s see if the hype was real or just good editing 🔥

situations.q: How do you enter Creator House?

reader.text: Beyond the gate, the villa glows in the sun. You step inside — and freeze for a second. You’d only ever seen a house like this while doomscrolling your feed.
Everyone in the lounge goes still. Ria asks {crush} —
That’s the one whose reel blew up last month, right? 👀
Um… yeah. Yeah, I know them.
{crush}’s eyes meet yours for a split second — then look away. It’s been 3 years. But you still remember that look.

choices.s: Let the house come to you.

dm.text: The quiet type? Interesting. I read people like you fast. 😏
One piece of advice — everyone in this house is acting. I can tell you who’s hiding what. Talk later? 💅

choices.s: Confident, loud, unforgettable.

post.caption: Creator House unlocked. 🔥 Nobody sneaks in here — definitely not me. Day 1, let’s gooo. #CreatorHouse #Day1

reactions.text: Loud arrivals are usually one of two things — confidence or overcompensation. Filing that away. 👑
YES BRO this energy 😭🔥 welcome to the madhouse
day 1 entry already this loud?? this season is gonna be CHAOS 👀

B.caption: Some people show up. Some people make an entrance. Volume at max from Day 1. Let’s see how long the battery lasts. 🤍

situations.title: First Reel
body: By afternoon, the house drops its first content challenge — one common trend, one question: who pulls the most views. The golden light is perfect.
Ria stands up straight, flips her hair, and announces it like the result's already locked: "I'll go first. Set the bar, then you guys can follow."
{ally} leans in at your ear: "Bro, either match her energy — or flip the whole format and parody it. It'll go viral *and* piss Ria off."

react.text: Ria really turned herself into the benchmark 😭 come on, let’s parody her — this house will lose it 🔥

situations.q: What will you do for your first reel?

reader.text: The first announcement blasts through the house speakers. First challenge — one trend, one winner. Win it, and you get followers… and maybe the season’s first big brand deal. Everyone’s already grabbed their phones.
I’m going first. This kind of thing comes with experience — not everyone can pull it off. The rest of you can decide what to do after you see my reel. 👑
Ria set the bar so high the whole house went quiet for a second. That’s her move — say you’re the best first, so everyone else has to measure themselves against you.
Bro listen — two options. Either match her energy and go head-to-head, or flip her whole 'aesthetic morning routine' thing into a parody. Funny, viral, and it’ll shake Ria’s ego a little. 😏
Ria made herself the standard. Either hold up a mirror to her, or stay in your own lane. First reel — everyone’s watching.

choices.t: Match Ria’s energy — post a parody reel.
choices.s: Rip her format to shreds. Guaranteed viral, and Ria definitely won’t be happy.

post.caption: POV: someone spends 3 hours setting up their 'effortless aesthetic morning routine' 💅✨ (it’s parody, relax 😂) #CreatorHouse #Day1

reactions.text: Cute. Without my reel, you wouldn’t even have content. I’m flattered. 👀
OKAY not the day 1 shots being fired 💅 I'm obsessed, keep going babe
A parody of Ria on DAY 1?? bro I genuinely can’t decide if that’s brave or insane 😭

choices.t: Stay in your lane — hype up {ally}.
choices.s: Don’t play Ria’s game. Build your own original angle with {ally}.

dm.text: Dude you fully ignored Ria and made your own thing 😭 respect
The easiest move was taking a cheap shot at her. You didn’t. You played on your own strength.
Everyone here thinks I’m just jokes. You might be the first person who focused on the work, not the drama. I’ll remember that. 🔥

A.caption: It’s not flattery when you’ve got nothing original of your own. Copying my reel from Day 1 already. I’m just that iconic. 🤍 #CreatorHouse

situations.title: Terrace, Night
body: It's 1 AM. The house noise has finally cooled off, the cameras inside have gone to sleep. You're on the terrace — first time alone, first time breathing properly.
The door opens just a little. {crush}. Two mugs of coffee, one for you. No ring light, no audience. Just the city lights spilling out into the distance.
{crush} comes over and leans on the railing beside you. "There are no cameras here," they say softly. "So... what are you really like?"

react.text: Everyone downstairs is asleep. Come up to the terrace… just 2 mins. No camera, promise. ✨

reader.text: It’s 1 a.m. and the villa is dead quiet. No ring lights on downstairs, no phones up. For the first time, it feels like you’re not performing.
The terrace door opens. {crush} — two coffee mugs in hand. All day, everyone saw the in-front-of-camera version. This version of {crush} is different. Guarded. Real.
Here, your coffee. I was escaping the circus downstairs. 😅 All day everyone’s been walking around wearing their 'content face'… yours too, right? 🥺
{crush} takes a sip of coffee and stares off into the distance. Then slowly — like this isn’t a question they ask just anyone — turns to you.
There’s no camera here. No followers. So… tell me the truth. How are you, really? ✨
No audience. Just you, them, and this question. Will you actually listen — or play it cool and move on?

choices.s: Drop the mask. Coffee, honesty, and something unfinished that’s been there for three years.

dm.text: You stopped. The easiest thing would’ve been to change the subject, crack a joke. You didn’t. 🥺
You know, for three years I’ve been wondering — if that night had gone differently, what then? And now you’re here, standing in front of me, completely real.
Don’t tell anyone about tonight. This version of you… that was just for me. Good night. ✨

choices.t: Then tell me why you’re showing up now — where were you 3 years ago?
choices.s: True. But first, we settle the score. Ask the three-year question straight.

dm.text: Straight shot. 😅 …fair. You’ve earned the right to ask that.
Three years ago, I got scared. You never said anything, I never asked — and time slipped through our fingers.
Why now? …I don’t know. But you’re asking, which means something’s still there. Just… not tonight. Good night. 🙂

A.caption: 1 AM on the terrace, two people, no cameras rolling, just coffee. We’re not saying anything but… we’re seeing everything 👀 #CreatorHouse

B.caption: 1 AM on the terrace — started with coffee, then something old came back up. They both came back looking different. This wasn’t light 👀🌙 #CreatorHouse

situations.title: Zoya's Offer
body: Everyone's asleep. One kitchen light is still on, and Zoya's standing there — two mugs of chai, one for you. "Sit. Even the camera's asleep now."

She's sweet, *very* sweet. "I like you, genuinely. That's why I'm telling you — everyone in this house is saying something behind your back. I hear everything. I can tell you... if we're on each other's side."
Then she leans in a little: "So... what did you think of Ria? Be honest." Her eyes are smiling, but she's listening for one name.

react.text: I’m on your side, babe. Just… trust has to go both ways, right? 💅

situations.q: Do you play along with Zoya or keep your distance?

reader.text: 1 AM. The whole house is asleep. One lonely kitchen light — and Zoya, holding two mugs of chai like she’s been waiting just for you.
Sit, babe. Even the camera’s asleep. I just wanted to see if you’re okay. 🫶
She holds out the chai. Sweet voice, warm smile. "Everyone in this house is saying something behind your back. I hear everything. If you want, I can feed you intel."
Just one thing — what do you really think about Ria? This stays between us. 👀
Her eyes are smiling. But you know better — everything Zoya says comes with a screenshot. Whatever you say tonight could be on someone else’s phone tomorrow.
And babe… one last thing. 🤫 Last night, terrace, 1 AM — you and {crush}, coffee. I saw it. Haven’t told anyone… yet.

choices.t: Play along — get a little intel
choices.s: You earn her trust. But now you owe her — and she’s got that terrace thing on you.

dm.text: Ugh, I knew you were smart. 🫶
What you said about Ria… honestly, same. We totally match wavelengths, babe.
And that terrace thing? 🤫 Stays between us. I’m on your side now. Just one day, I might ask you for a tiny favor too. 💅

choices.s: Stay safe. But now Zoya has that terrace card — and she’s not happy.

dm.text: Aww, it’s okay. 🫶
You’re a little guarded, cute. I’m not offended, promise.
Just saying, babe — people having 1 AM "coffee dates" on the terrace 👀 don’t keep their secrets secret for long. Think about that. ✨

A.caption: 1 AM kitchen talks with my new fave in the house 🫶 sweetest energy in here! #CreatorHouse #Day2

B.caption: Zoya offered midnight chai and got a poker face in return 🧊 babe really made an enemy on day 2?? 🍿 #CreatorHouse

situations.title: Ria, On Camera
body: Afternoon. In front of everyone, camera on. Ria walks up to you — perfectly lit, perfectly calm. "I was thinking we should do a collab. My reach could double your content in a day."
She smiles and adds one more line: "Just one small thing — I'll handle the caption and the credit. And next time I take a stand on something, you're with me. Fair?"
The whole house is watching. The reach is a gift — but Ria never gives anything for free. Say yes, and you're under her. Say no, and on camera, you just rejected the queen bee.

react.text: I don’t offer collabs to everyone. I’m offering one to you. Think about it — this offer comes once. 👑

situations.q: Take Ria’s collab or stay independent?

reader.text: Afternoon. The cameras are rolling, the whole house is in the hall. Ria walks right up to you — totally composed, like she wrote this scene herself.
Let’s do a collab. My reach will double your numbers in a day. Simple math. 👑
I’ll handle the caption and credit. And when I take a stand on something, you stand with me. That’s it. Fair, right?
The reach is real — one collab and your follower count shoots up. But this is Ria’s house, and her gifts always come with a chain attached.

choices.t: Take the collab — take the reach
choices.s: Follower jump is guaranteed. But now you owe Ria.

post.caption: Collab drop 🚨 with @riaofficial. Even I’m shocked at the reach 📈👑 #CreatorHouse #Day2

reactions.text: Good choice. You get how this house works. Welcome to the top table. 👑
Oho, Team Ria already? 💅 noted, babe.
Day 2 and already under the queen’s umbrella 🌂 smart or scared? 👀

choices.s: Your name, your terms. Smaller reach, but the respect is yours.

dm.text: Interesting. You said no. 👑
You’re either brave, or new — haven’t decided yet.
No worries. I only make offers once. Let’s see how far your reach gets on its own. 🤍

A.caption: BREAKING: newbie took Ria’s collab 📈 sure, the reach is coming — but nothing in this house is free 👑🔗 #CreatorHouse #Day2

B.caption: Some people build their own name. Respect. Let’s see how big that name gets. 🤍 #CreatorHouse

situations.title: First Danger Night
body: First eviction night. Inside, everything's quiet — but outside, the internet is exploding. Your name is trending — and right next to it, one word: "EVICTED?"
Every follower count feels like a vote now. Inside the house, you can see your standing in numbers — and right now, that number is slipping. You can't sleep. Your phone is in your hand.
You need to post something — prove your worth. Two ways to play it: honest and from the heart, or one huge viral swing that either saves you or sinks you.

react.text: Bro, your name’s all over the internet right now, but don’t panic. Post something — something only YOU can post. I’m right here. 🔥

situations.q: What do you post on danger night?

reader.text: 2 AM. First eviction night. The house is silent, but your phone screen is lit up — your name is trending, and with it, one question: are you leaving?
This house shows you the truth through one thing only — followers. Every number is a vote. And right now, that number isn’t steady. It can drop.
Listen. Everyone outside is talking crap in your name. So answer them — with a post. Something only you can put out there. 🔥
Two paths. One: honest, shaky truth — straight from the heart. The other: a big viral swing — spectacle, risk, something that either saves the night or sinks you.
This post is your read on the audience. Tomorrow morning, the follower count will tell you if you survived. How do you play it?

choices.s: From the heart, with shaking hands. Slow, but real.

post.caption: Truth? I'm scared of leaving tonight. But I came in here as my real self — whether I'm here tomorrow or not. If my story means something to you, stay with me. 🤍 #CreatorHouse #DangerNight

reactions.text: Bro, this wasn't a joke — it hit me straight in the heart. Listen, you're not going anywhere. Even if the numbers drop, I'm still right here. Get some sleep tonight, I'll stay up. 🔥
This… was so real it made me cry. 🥺 Please don't go.

choices.s: Spectacle. Everything on the line. Win big or lose big.

situations.title: {crush}'s Collab
body: Morning. {crush} corners you with their phone in hand, a half-edited reel on the screen. "I have an idea. You and me. A collab. Your reach, my edit, and the chemistry is kinda obvious."
By the numbers, {crush} has fewer followers than you. But this reel? It could blow up. For both of you. And everyone in the house will see exactly whose side you're on.
{crush}'s eyes are lit up, a little nervous too. "I just need a yes or no. Don't overthink it."

react.text: If we do this together… people are gonna talk. But I don't care. Do you? 🥺

reader.text: Morning. {crush} pulls you aside — a half-finished reel paused on their phone, waiting to be cut.
The two of us. One collab. Your reach, my edit… the chemistry's obvious to everyone, right? 🥺
A collab like this in the house makes a statement. Everyone will see whose side you're on — and so will Ria.
I just need a yes or no. Don't go by the numbers… go with us. ✨
One reel that could lift both of you up — but also paint a target on your back. Gamble on followers, or play it safe?

choices.t: Do it together — make the reel

situations.title: Nominations
body: The house lights shift — red. Production's voice booms out: 'Time for nominations.' Everyone lines up, hearts pounding.
One by one, the names are revealed. And then two names stay on the screen — this week's in danger.
{ally} gives a small smile, but you know better — they're shaken underneath. Dev stays quiet, like always. Your person is in danger.

react.text: Bro, I’m in danger 😳 but don’t stress, I’ll handle it. You focus on your game.

situations.q: {ally} is in danger — what do you do right now?

reader.text: The house lights turn red. Production: "This week’s nominations." Everyone’s lined up. Nobody moves.
(calm) Whatever happens, happens. I’m happy with my journey.
Two names stop on the screen — Dev and {ally}. {ally}'s eyes meet yours for a split second.
Look… I’m okay. Really. Don’t tank your numbers for me, okay? This is my fight. 🙂
The person closest to you could be leaving this week. Right now — do you reassure them, or protect your own game?

choices.s: Emotional commitment. They know you’re with them.

dm.text: Bro… what you just said. 🥺 Nobody in this house talks like that.
Whether I go or stay — you’re my person. But listen, spend your numbers carefully. I mean it.

choices.s: Everyone in here fights for themselves. Standing first.

dm.text: Yeah yeah, I got it. Everyone fights for themselves. 🙂
It’s fine, bro. Let’s see tomorrow night who actually stands up for who.

A.caption: found one person in this house who stood up for me without thinking 🥺 everyone else was busy protecting their own numbers #CreatorHouse #Nominations

B.caption: the second nominations hit, loyalties get real obvious 👀 who’s willing to spend numbers for who, we’ll find out tomorrow night 🍿 #CreatorHouse

situations.title: Zoya’s Receipts
body: Afternoon. Everyone's phones buzz at the same time. Zoya has posted something — no names, but everyone knows who it's about.
Screenshots. {crush}'s private messages — sent to someone else. And one line lands like a punch to the gut: 'Need to keep them close, the votes are coming in. It's just strategy.'
Terrace. Coffee. A 3-year 'connection.' In one second, it all looks different. Was any of it real... or were you just a move?

react.text: I didn’t say anything, babe 💅 the screenshots did. Now you decide what you want to do. 👀

situations.q: What do you do about Zoya’s leak?

reader.text: Afternoon. Zoya drops a "no-name" post — but everyone in the house knows exactly who it’s about. In the comments, your name and {crush}'s are getting dragged.
In the screenshot, {crush}'s own words — to someone else: "Need to keep them close, the numbers are doubling." Your breath catches.
Oh no, did that sting? 🙈 I only showed the truth, babe. Now you see it, right — in this house, even "feelings" are part of the game. 👀
The heat is on, and it's all on camera. Your game is on the line, and so is your heart. Zoya's smiling — one shot, two hits.
In front of everyone, you were made to look used. Blow this up and tell your truth — or keep it together quietly?

choices.s: Publicly. Protect your own name, even if it gets messy.

post.caption: Screenshots without context are only half the truth. 🎬 What you're calling strategy is my story — and I won't let someone else's edit define it. #CreatorHouse

reactions.text: Ooh, fighting spirit 💅 but screenshots are still screenshots, babe 👀
Bold. But now the whole house is gonna see your "story" differently. 👑
they answered the screenshots HEAD ON 😭🔥 biggest twist of the season #CreatorHouse

choices.s: Don't react. That's exactly what Zoya wants. Process it in private.

dm.text: Bro, don't react, that's literally what she wants 😭 Nothing burns her more than silence.
And that screenshot… listen. Maybe it did start as strategy. But I've seen {crush}'s eyes when they talk about you. That's not fake anymore.
Zoya lit the fire. Don't be water, and don't be fire either. Just… ask {crush} yourself, off-screen.

situations.title: Two Hearts, Two Paths
body: Night. Everyone's asleep. {crush} finds you on the terrace — a little wrecked after the Zoya drama, a little brave for showing up. "I've been thinking about this all day. Whatever this is between us... I want to figure it out. For real."
"But I know your standing's shaky right now. If we get closer, people will talk even more. Your followers will care." {crush} pauses. "So I just need to know — do I come first, or does the game?"
No cameras. No captions. Just you, {crush}, and a question you can't dodge.

react.text: I don't want drama. I just want an honest answer. I can wait for you… can you wait for me? 🥺

reader.text: Night. The terrace is empty, everyone's asleep. {crush} was waiting for you — a little shaken after Zoya's drama, but still trying to hold it together.
I've been thinking about this all day. Whatever this is between us… I really want to figure it out. 🥺
But {crush} knows this too — your game is weak right now. If you get close, the followers will feel some type of way.
I just want to know one thing… do I come first, or does your game? ✨
No cameras, no captions. Just you and that question — heart or followers?

choices.s: The game can wait. This feeling can't.

dm.text: You… you chose me. Before the followers. 🥺
I know that could cost you in the game. But you still said it. That's what matters most.
I'm with you. And this isn't some 'almost-something' anymore… it's something. ✨

choices.s: In here, followers are survival. Not now.

dm.text: The game. Got it. You made it clear, so thank you. 🙂
I wasn't wrong to take the chance… maybe the timing was. Or the guy.
Okay. I'll back off. Play your game — I'll be watching. 🥺

situations.title: Second Danger Night
body: The speaker crackles again. Another danger night. But this time, before the name is even read, you already know — because the one at the bottom isn't you.
{ally}'s name is on the screen. Lowest standing. And in the whole house, only one person has enough reach to pull them up — you.
You have your own standing. You can spend it — save {ally}, at your own cost. Or keep yourself safe and let them fall.

react.text: Dude, my name dropped to the bottom 😭 don't stress. Seriously — play for yourself, don't get caught up in me.

situations.q: {ally} is in danger. Will you spend your standing to save them?

reader.text: Night. Living room. Everyone's standing in a line. The speaker comes on — second danger night. Tonight, one person's name is at the very bottom.
The screen lights up. The numbers are right there for everyone to see. Your eyes land on the name — and something drops in your chest. It's {ally}.
Damn… that's me, bro. 😭 It's okay, it happens. You take care of yourself. Seriously — don't risk it for me, your number isn't safe either.
And then you see your power. Your reach is big enough that if you spend the whole day pushing {ally} — reels, tags, story — they could survive. But your own standing will drop.
If you save them, it costs you. Your followers, their life in the game. Or keep yourself on top and let them fall alone. What do you do?

choices.t: Shield them — put your standing on the line
choices.s: Pull {ally} up at the cost of your own followers. Friendship first.

dm.text: Bro, you really… spent the whole day on me. 😭
I was watching your number drop and you still kept tagging me. You risked your spot. For me. Nobody in this house does that.
I joke around so much, people think nothing gets to me. Today, it did. You're my person. I'll remember this till my last breath. 🔥

choices.s: Your standing comes first. On danger night, you save yourself first.

post.caption: In this house, everyone fights their own battle. I'm fighting mine. 🎯 #DangerNight #CreatorHouse

reactions.text: Finally. Someone who gets that this game isn't a group project. Cold, but correct. 👑

situations.title: {crush}'s Call
body: Danger night is over. The house is asleep. Your phone lights up — {crush}.
"I'm on the terrace. Alone. If you want to come... I'm here." They're not saying come. They're just saying the door's open.
They've seen every choice you've made so far. Now they're leaving the decision to you. Are you going?

react.text: I'm on the terrace. Alone. 🥺 If you want to come, come. I'm not forcing you… just saying.

situations.q: {crush} is on the terrace. Will you go, or let it go?

reader.text: The noise of the dangerous night has finally drained away. The house is sunk in darkness. You're still awake — heart still racing. Your phone lights up.
You asleep? I'm on the terrace… alone. After all that drama downstairs, up here it's just the wind and me. 🥺
Look, I'm not trying to force you. Just… if you want to come, I'm here. And if not, that's okay too. ✨
This isn't the {crush} who's guarded in front of the cameras. This is the one who let their guard down — just for you. And they know every choice you've made so far.
She's putting the choice in your hands. Will you take the stairs — or put your phone down and go to sleep? What'll you do?

choices.t: Go to the terrace — go see her
choices.s: Take the stairs. Stop putting this off.

dm.text: You came. 🥺 You actually came.
You know, all night I kept telling myself — don't text them, what will they think. But you came anyway, before I even had to say it properly. So maybe I wasn't the only one feeling this.
This house turns everyone into a performance. But up on that terrace, with you… I was just me. For the first time in forever. Maybe for the first time in 3 years. Thank you. ✨

choices.t: Let it go — put the phone down
choices.s: Not tonight. Clear head, guarded heart.

dm.text: It's okay. Go to sleep. 🙂
I'll sit here a little longer. The breeze is nice. You get some rest.
…truth? For one second, I really thought you'd come. My mistake. I'm used to sitting alone anyway. Good night. 🥺

A.caption: Some nights never make it to the feed. Tonight's one of them. 🌙✨ #CreatorHouse

B.caption: Terrace, alone, cold breeze. That's all I needed anyway. Wasn't waiting for anyone. Not at all. 🙂🌙 #CreatorHouse

situations.title: Ria, Unmasked
body: 2 AM. You have the screenshots Zoya leaked — and in them is the full truth about Ria. That 2.1M glamour image is standing on borrowed money. Unpaid sponsor dues, brand threats, all of it.
One post. One expose. And by morning, Ria's whole image — the one that's made you feel small since day 1 — will crack in front of everyone. The followers will come to you.
Or you delete the screenshots. Stay clean. Don't get your hands dirty with Zoya's mess. Your call.

react.text: hii babe 💅 left these screenshots for you. your move now. post them… let everyone see. 👀

situations.q: Ria's truth — will you expose her, or stay clean?

reader.text: 2 AM. Everyone's asleep. A folder pops up on your phone — sent by Zoya. Screenshots. And in them is the truth Ria's been hiding for 2 years.
hii babe ✨ got them? dug all this up with effort. Ria's whole 'luxury life' — built on borrowed money. sponsor messages, unpaid dues, everything. 👀
I don't wanna get my hands dirty. but you? you post it. by morning, she's done. and all her followers… over here. 💅
This is the Ria who called you 'small-town' from day 1. The one who made you feel small in front of every camera. One tap, and her mask comes off.
One post — Ria's done, and the followers are yours. Or delete the screenshots — clean hands, smaller reach. What do you do?

choices.s: Rip Ria's mask off. The followers will come. But yeah, it's ruthless.

post.caption: In this house, there's always something hiding behind everyone's 'aesthetic.' Tonight, I'm putting a few things out in the open. Truth over image. 👀 #CreatorHouse #Receipts

reactions.text: So this is who you are. Fine. You want my throne? You'll learn how heavy it is. This isn't over. 👑
AND SCENE 💅✨ see, babe? told you. you did what I needed done — and the blame lands on you. genius. 👀
NOT THE RECEIPTS 😭😭 ria's whole empire on borrowed money?? this house just went NUCLEAR #CreatorHouse #Exposed

choices.s: Don't get involved in Zoya's game. Less reach, full dignity.

dm.text: Bro, I saw what Zoya was sending. The whole house was waiting on that folder. 😳
And you deleted it. Ria never once played straight with you — you had the chance to ruin her, and you didn't take it.
The followers can come later, dude. But who you were tonight? Zoya could never. I respect you for that. For real. 🔥

A.caption: the house is at WAR 🍿 team-exposed vs team-ria… after this, nobody's going back to normal 👀🔥 #CreatorHouse #Receipts

B.caption: Someone had my life in their hands last night. They chose to walk away clean. I don't forget things like that. 🤍 #CreatorHouse

choices.s: Rip Ria's mask off. The followers will come. But yeah, it's ruthless.

post.caption: In this house, there's always something hiding behind everyone's 'aesthetic.' Tonight, I'm putting a few things out in the open. Truth over image. 👀 #CreatorHouse #Receipts

reactions.text: So this is who you are. Fine. You want my throne? You'll learn how heavy it is. This isn't over. 👑
AND SCENE 💅✨ you did what I needed done — and the blame lands on you. genius. 👀
NOT THE RECEIPTS 😭😭 this house just went NUCLEAR #CreatorHouse #Exposed

choices.s: Don't get involved in Zoya's game. Less reach, full dignity.

dm.text: (from outside, voice note) Bro, I was literally sitting right there — Zoya dropped the folder. 😳
And you deleted it. Gave up the followers, kept your dignity. I'm saying this even from outside the house — you're that guy.
Go win. For me too. 🔥

situations.title: The Last Big Decision
body: The finale's tomorrow. Tonight is the house's last content window — one post, prime slot, the whole internet watching. It'll hit your numbers directly.
On one side: a clean winner move — you, alone, on top. Perfect for fame. But you'll have to put whatever's been building with {crush} on the side. Publicly.
On the other: spend this night with someone for real — forget the numbers, choose {crush}. No cameras.

react.text: Tomorrow's the finale. Tonight decides whether someone came here to win, or for something else. I'm watching both. 🤍

situations.q: Last night — play to win, or play for the romance?

reader.text: Late night. The villa is quiet. Less than twenty-four hours till the finale. The house’s last content window is open right now — one slot, prime time, the whole internet online.
There’s a clean winner move ready — just you, on top, full spotlight. The numbers will love it. You just have to keep {crush} out of frame. In front of everyone.
Tomorrow it all ends, right? So… just for tonight, no cameras. Just you and me. Is that possible? 🥺
On one side, fifty thousand people. On the other, one person who’s stopped for real for the first time.
This is the question that’s been hiding since Day 1 — followers or feelings? Tonight, no lies.

choices.s: Post the winner move. The spotlight is yours alone.

post.caption: Ten days. One house. And I’m still here — alone, on my own. Finale tomorrow. Everything else is noise. 🏆 #CreatorHouse #FinaleEve

reactions.text: The night before the finale and you’re doing a solo flex. Cold. Smart. That’s the game. 👑
Guess there wasn’t room for me in the frame. Got it. It’s fine. 🙂
FINALE EVE and this guy went solo 👀 dropped everyone for the numbers. iconic or ice-cold? #CreatorHouse

choices.s: Skip the slot. Tonight, be with {crush}, no cameras.

dm.text: Wait… you gave up the prime slot? The night before the finale? 🥺
Not for the numbers… for me? Really?
Come to the terrace. Cameras off. Tonight it’s just us. I’ve… I’ve never felt this with anyone before. 🌙

A.caption: Finale eve and someone’s shining solo in prime slot — after keeping their closest bond out of frame. Numbers up. Heart? Who knows. 👀🏆 #CreatorHouse #Day5

B.caption: Someone gave up fifty thousand people tonight… for one person. Me. 🌙 Whatever happens tomorrow, tonight is mine. #FinaleEve

situations.title: Live Finale
body: Studio lights. 1.1 lakh people live. Ria, {ally}, {crush} — everyone's on stage, everyone's with you. The host opens the envelope.
"And this season's result…" — pause. All of India is holding its breath.
It's your name. These ten days have narrowed down to this one moment. Now it's just — how do you take it?

react.text: Your name came up. I didn’t teach you this — you earned it yourself. Now show them who you are. 🤍

situations.q: The result is in — how do you take it?

reader.text: Live finale. Studio lights, 1.1 lakh people online. On stage: Ria, {ally}, {crush} — all safe, all standing with you.
And the winner of this season… is… this name. Congratulations. The stage is yours. 🎤
Applause. The camera zooms in on your face. {ally}’s eyes are filling up. {crush} is just looking at you — like everything led to this one moment.
Ten days. One mic. Whatever you say now — that’s what people will remember. It’s yours. How do you take it?

choices.s: You earned this. Take it like you own the whole thing.

dm.text: OYE WINNER 😭🔥 you were up there on that stage like the house belonged to you. I knew it, bro.
You took it like it was yours. No begging. that’s my guy. 🔥
You really made it yours. 🥺 And I’m glad I saw you that night — before everyone else.

choices.s: This wasn’t just yours. Take everyone with you.

dm.text: bro you said our name on stage 😭 in front of everyone. i lowkey cried.
the trophy’s yours, but you made it everyone’s. that’s why you won. 🔥
You pulled me into your moment. 🥺 You’re a winner — but a human first. That’s what I’ll remember.

A.caption: AND THE WINNER IS… 🏆 the way they owned that stage like the trophy was already theirs. season over. main character confirmed. 👑 #CreatorHouse #Finale

B.caption: my guy won 😭🔥 and the first thing he did after lifting the trophy was say our name. this was the only guy who deserved to win. #Finale #CreatorHouse

reader.text: Live finale. Studio lights, 1.1 lakh people online. On stage: Ria and {crush} — {ally} didn’t make it to the end of this journey, but you can still feel their presence today.
And the winner of this season… is… this name. Congratulations. The stage is yours. 🎤
Applause. {crush}’s eyes are filling up — they’re looking at you like everything led to this one moment.
Ten days. One mic. It’s yours. How do you take it?

choices.s: You earned this. Take it like you own it.

dm.text: You really made it yours. 🥺 And me? I saw you that night — before everyone else.
(from outside) OYE WINNER 😭🔥 I’m out of the house, but I still got to see you win. you took it like you had every right to. that’s my guy.

choices.s: This wasn’t just yours. Take everyone with you.

dm.text: You pulled me into your moment. 🥺 You’re a winner — but a human first. That’s what I’ll remember.
(from outside) bro you said our name on stage 😭 I cried watching from outside. that’s why you won.

narrLines.text: You’re the newest one here. Nobody knows you — yet.

narrChars:
Luxury. Lifestyle. Untouchable.
Everything is curated. She knows it.

Everyone's friend. No one's.
He creates the drama. And he's always rolling on it.

The viral dancer. 23 years old.
Don't turn her into just the "cute dance girl" — but will these people even listen?

Fitness. Brand deals. Grindset.
Loyalty's for sale — whoever pays more.
On-camera: sweet. Off-camera? I'll cut straight through you.

dmHooks.ria: So you’re the new creator who just walked in, huh. ||| I noticed your entry — then again, everyone did. ||| Let’s see if you last here, or if you end up being just another name. 👀
dmHooks.kabir: Oh damn, fresh blood’s here! 😭 ||| Listen, everyone in this house is playing their own game — I can tell you what’s really going on. ||| Stick with me. Surviving solo in here is rough. 🔥
dmHooks.ananya: Hey, I’m Ananya 🥺 ||| Things can get kinda intense in here — don’t freak out, I’ve got you. ||| You feel different from everyone else. In this house, that’s rare.
dmHooks.dev: I saw your reach. Solid. ||| Everyone here is in it for content, me included — straight up. ||| Wanna collab? Good for both of us. Think about it. 💪
dmHooks.zoya: Heyy! 🫶 ||| I’m Zoya. Just wanted to check if you’re settling in okay. ||| Everyone here is competing with each other... I genuinely want you to feel comfortable. If you need anything, tell me. 💅

kabir: Look, look — you're getting the game 🔥

ria.text: Easy to say when you have it all 🙄

dev.text: This is all brand PR, right? 😅

ria.tagline: The queen bee of the house. Always perched above everyone else — and she knows it.
ria.persona: "I’m clean, I’m classy" — that’s the whole vibe. Untouchable energy. Everyone measures themselves against her.
ria.wants: Landing some big luxury brand ambassador deal — so this whole rich-girl act finally feels real.
ria.fears: Getting exposed. That it’s all fake. One more shove and the whole image comes down like a house of cards.
ria.truth: This whole "old money" thing? It’s running on borrowed cash. The money she flashes? She doesn’t actually have it.
ria.secret: After shoots, she quietly returns the expensive clothes — gets the refund and keeps moving. And someone has the screenshots.

ties.label: RIVAL
ties.note: A brand deal Ria thought was locked in — Kabir cut her off in the middle. They’ve been at war ever since.

ties.label: FRENEMY
ties.note: All "hii babe" on the surface, but underneath? Ready to eat each other alive.

ties.label: DISMISSES
ties.note: Calls her "just a girl who can shake it" and doesn’t even count her as real competition.

ties.label: ALLY (FRAGILE)
ties.note: Less friendship, more transaction. They’re together as long as it benefits both of them.

kabir.tagline: Friends with everyone, loyal to no one. There’s always something else going on behind that smile.
kabir.persona: He’s all "I’m just vibes, bro." Wins everyone over with a joke and makes them feel like they’re his people.
kabir.wants: Becoming the main character of this whole house. His story, his spotlight, all of it.
kabir.fears: People realizing he’s the real villain.
kabir.truth: He sets up other people’s fights himself — drama is his best content. And he keeps screenshots on everyone as backup.
kabir.secret: The very first rumor in the house? He leaked it himself. Kept his name out of it. Then sat back and enjoyed the show.

ties.label: RIVAL
ties.note: Ever since the brand deal sabotage, it’s been open war between them.

ties.label: DUO (USING)
ties.note: On camera, they’re the funny duo. Off camera, they’re both using each other.

ties.label: MANIPULATES
ties.note: Ananya thinks he’s her friend. He’s using her.

ananya.tagline: The most straightforward one in the house. What you see is what you get — and that’s exactly her weakness.
ananya.persona: Sweet, bubbly, the viral dancer who blew up on Reels overnight.
ananya.wants: For people to see her as a *real* creator — not just "some dancer."
ananya.fears: The same people she trusted using her and tossing her aside.
ananya.truth: She’s gone deeper into these games than she can handle — and she knows it. The smile is real. So is the fear underneath.
ananya.secret: No schemes, no screenshots. That total innocence is exactly what makes her the easiest target.

ties.label: HURT BY
ties.note: Ria’s "thumka girl" jab hit her right in the heart.

ties.label: USED BY
ties.note: She trusts him blindly. She really shouldn’t.

dev.tagline: A total sellout. Even loyalty is just another deal to him.
dev.persona: Discipline, motivation, brand after brand. "You didn’t wake up at 5? That’s why you’re behind."
dev.wants: Stack up the most brand money before the house chapter ends.
dev.fears: People writing him off as just some dumb gym bro who got lucky.
dev.truth: He goes wherever the clout is. And he’s studied strategy way more than anyone realizes.
dev.secret: One of his supplement brands flopped — and he’s quietly drowning in debt. Every deal in here is him trying to climb out of that hole.

ties.label: ALLY
ties.note: A relationship of convenience. As long as the clout’s coming, it lasts.

ties.label: USING
ties.note: Comedy duo on camera, sizing each other up behind the scenes.

zoya.tagline: Camera on: "hii babies 🥰". Camera off: knives out.
zoya.persona: The beauty / GRWM girl. Sweet, soft, everyone’s favorite on screen.
zoya.wants: Become the house beauty queen and leave every rival in the dust.
zoya.fears: Losing that sweet image that hides all the cruelty underneath.
zoya.truth: Camera off, sweetness gone. "I’ll cut her down with a smile."
zoya.secret: She leaks bad photos of her rivals and lets the fan pages do the rest. She’s got one of Ria’s pics right now — locked and loaded.

ties.label: FRENEMY
ties.note: The rivalry that keeps the whole house gossiping.
